verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no sandbox or isolated test environment that keeps agent work away from production data. Diff review and undo let you roll back edits, and design previews and local dev-server previews let you check changes, but none of these isolate data or execution. A community user notes the agents run directly on the host rather than sandboxed by default, and the Supabase plugin can run database queries and migrations with no documented environment separation.
